technicalDecisions: Dedicated identity credentials never enter the financial checkout-marker namespace or existing Supabase token store.
Exact native application/origin/club policy is approved by host configuration, never populated from Dart requests. Production defaults stay disabled and authorize no scopes.
Caller-observed deadlines never cancel a native CAS or unlock its lease. FIFO drain/release stays behind native work; engine abort closes the owner only after active work settles.

Android key storage is non-exportable AES-256-GCM in AndroidKeyStore and journal files are private/no-backup. API35+ adds the unlocked-device requirement when creating new keys; surviving older keys do not constitute hardware-policy attestation.
Identity iOS policy is WhenPasscodeSetThisDeviceOnly and nonsynchronized. Checkout policy remains WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly; its existing snapshot/channel format is preserved.
Apple metadata ambiguity and accessibility/synchronization policy are checked before exactly one persistent-reference data read. Security interaction is explicitly disallowed.
Portable tests use synthetic keys or test-only blob backends. SDK compilation and query construction tests establish source/API behavior, not physical OS storage acceptance.
Source evidence and logs are hashed; no prior phase3 report or preserved Drive source was rewritten.
remainingLocalIntegration: Root-owned identity/membership composition and native UI must consume this dedicated adapter; no existing Supabase or checkout UI flow was switched here.

Full offline Rayon Gradle compilation still requires reproducible resolution of Flutter integration_test androidx.test:runner:1.2+ version listing. No SDK/dependency pin was changed or failure hidden.
